explanation: Enumerate all three cut positions with at most three digits per part. Keep a candidate only if each part is at most 255 and has no leading zero unless the part is exactly zero.
timeComplexity: O(1) bounded work: at most 27 cut combinations for at most 12 digits.
spaceComplexity: O(1) bounded auxiliary and output space for IPv4 addresses.
